0022600205.text: The Detroit Pistons, 6-3 and 1st in the Central, host the Washington Wizards in the Pistons' 10th game of the 2026-27 season. Detroit has lost its last two games, while Washington (4-6, 9th in the East) is on a three-game losing streak and sits 2.5 games behind for third in the Southeast. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Pistons won the series 3-1, including a 117-95 win in Washington on March 19, 2026. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), with Anthony Davis (ankle sprain) and Bilal Coulibaly (hand) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions.
